facts.text: I told the assistant to take into account what I told before regarding users information and insights.
Users feel frustration.
Users have fear of loss.
Users have fear of missing out.
Users experience lack of feedback.
Users have lack of trust or security.
Users feel waste of time.
About 21% of Spain's population is older than 65 years old.
About 7% of Spain's population suffers from some kind of disability.
The top 3 regions for disability in Spain are Catalonia, Madrid, and Andalusia.
About 88% of the population has a mobile device.
About 94.6% of users use their mobile device as their preferred device instead of a computer.
Spanish is the only available language on the platform.
The platform does not provide other languages such as Catalan or English.
There is no real-time, easy-to-exploit system for others to hijack and resell appointments on the black market.
The system fails to address some A11y tests and recommendations.
Users do not have a sense of trust that the service comes from an authority.
The platform is hard to navigate due to an overcomplicated user flow and poor information architecture.
The platform is not friendly for foreigners.
Foreigners have to go through the platform even though it is only available in Spanish.
I asked whether to use personas or archetypes.
I provided an archetype called "The Frustrated User" for users who experience frustration with the Cita Previa website.
I said "The Frustrated User" may feel overwhelmed or stressed by the process.
I said "The Frustrated User" may fear missing out on an appointment or losing valuable time.
I said "The Frustrated User" may feel lack of feedback or empathy from the website.
I provided an archetype called "The Skeptical User" for users who have concerns about the trustworthiness or security of the Cita Previa website.
I said "The Skeptical User" may fear the website is a scam.
I said "The Skeptical User" may fear personal information is at risk.
I said "The Skeptical User" may need additional reassurance or evidence of reliability before proceeding.
I provided an archetype called "The Time-Constrained User" for users with limited time to spend on the Cita Previa website.
I said "The Time-Constrained User" may look for a quick and efficient way to book an appointment.
I said "The Time-Constrained User" may be frustrated by delays or obstacles that prolong the process.
I said "The Time-Constrained User" includes older users, users with disabilities, and users who prefer to use mobile devices.
I said "The Time-Constrained User" includes foreigners who may be unfamiliar with the website or who do not speak Spanish.
I said "The Time-Constrained User" includes tech-savvy users who may have high expectations for the user experience.
I asked to improve the archetypes using the tone I would use for a Google UX Case Study.
I asked to use the tone as if it was a Microsoft UX Case Study.
